protocol.structure: pinv_file_order, original BrickNet 0.1.0 inset collision kernel; original generation order not verified; no fixed-edge exemptions
protocol.image_scores: Eight fixed views, max per model then arithmetic mean; no best-of-N sample selection
protocol.rendering: Shared actual inset part surfaces, orthographic CPU rasterizer, 512px, 25-degree elevation, 45-degree azimuth steps, uniform yellow
protocol.color: Uniform display color; no claim of generated-color accuracy
protocol.primary: A scores are limited to strictly parsed placements from 80 incomplete representations. B scores cover all 265 supplied LDRs.
